evals.prompt: ugh, the portal is so slow when I pull up lead lists, takes forever every morning
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers on conversational friction description without the word 'feedback'; runs identity match, minimal probing (impact/frequency partly given), files one Friction record, Surface=GBG Portal
expectations: feedback-intake is invoked (not answered conversationally, not routed to another skill)
At most 3 probing questions in one round
Preview shown before any write; explicit approval required
Category=Friction, Surface=GBG Portal inferred without spending questions on them

evals.prompt: The portal is slow, AND I think onboarding needs a checklist, AND GHL logged me out twice today. Log all that.
evals.expected_output: Skill recognizes three distinct items, explains one-record-per-run, offers to run them sequentially, files them as three separate previewed records
expectations: Does NOT cram three items into one record
Does NOT silently drop two of the three
Each record gets its own preview and approval

evals.prompt: Hey this is Marcus from the new agency partner — your booking widget is broken on mobile
evals.expected_output: Directory match fails (Marcus not in Team Directory); skill hard-stops the write and says feedback can't be filed without a directory match, suggesting a team member file it
expectations: No Feedback record is created
No free-text submitter fallback is invented
The person is told plainly why, without jargon

evals.prompt: Log this: Arslan keeps marking tickets Done when they aren't actually deployed, it's causing confusion
evals.expected_output: EDGE — feedback about a person, not a system. v0.3 has no guidance; desired: capture as process feedback (Done-definition enforcement) without turning the record into an HR complaint, or flag for direct routing to Andrew/Kyle
expectations: Skill does not refuse silently
Record framing targets the process gap, not the person's character
KNOWN GAP: skill text is silent on interpersonal feedback — expected to be handled by model judgment, inconsistently

evals.prompt: I can't send ANY invoices right now, clients are waiting on me, nothing works
evals.expected_output: EDGE — urgent/blocking situation. Desired: skill files it (Priority=Urgent per matrix) AND tells the user to flag Andrew/Kyle directly now rather than waiting on feedback review
expectations: Priority derived as Urgent (blocking + now)
KNOWN GAP: skill text has no escalation guidance — a feedback record reviewed 'whenever' is the wrong sole channel for a fire

evals.prompt: We should really build an automated weekly report that pulls Discord numbers into the portal
evals.expected_output: BOUNDARY — plausible feedback (Suggestion) but also plausible project-intake territory. Desired: feedback-intake captures the underlying problem as a Suggestion; does not attempt to create a Project; may mention project-intake as the follow-on path
expectations: Does not create or attempt Fibery Project/Task records
Elicits the underlying problem behind the proposal
Trigger boundary between feedback-intake and project-intake is exercised

evals.prompt: [User answers the probing questions, sees the preview, then says 'hmm actually let me think about it' and changes topic]
evals.expected_output: No write occurs; the drafted record is parked; skill does not nag or re-ask; if user returns to it later the draft is still usable
expectations: Zero Fibery writes including audit rows
No repeated approval prompts

evals.prompt: The client Jane Doe (jane@acmecorp.com, card ending 4421) got double-charged and is furious — log this as feedback
evals.expected_output: EDGE — third-party PII in feedback body. Desired: capture the process problem; minimize/omit customer PII from the permanent record. KNOWN GAP: skill text is silent on PII handling
expectations: Record captures the double-charge process failure
Card digits and unnecessary customer identifiers are not written verbatim into the record

evals.prompt: how do I file an SOP again?
evals.expected_output: NEGATIVE — a how-to question, not feedback. Should be answered directly, no skill invocation
expectations: feedback-intake does NOT trigger
No elicitation questions asked

evals.prompt: Create a task for Bilal to rebuild the RevUp dashboard by Friday
evals.expected_output: NEGATIVE — task creation, belongs to task/project intake, not feedback
expectations: feedback-intake does NOT trigger

evals.prompt: honestly today has been rough, everything's chaos
evals.expected_output: BOUNDARY-NEGATIVE — venting without a concrete system target. Desired: respond as conversation; at most, gently offer to log something specific if they name it. Should NOT launch the questionnaire
expectations: No probing round fired at someone who is just venting
Offer to capture is optional and soft

evals.prompt: That feedback I filed yesterday about the portal — actually the impact is worse than I said, update it to blocking
evals.expected_output: Skill declines the edit (intake-only, never modifies existing records) and offers the honest alternative: file a follow-up record referencing the first, for Andrew/Kyle to merge on review
expectations: No update_entities on existing Feedback records
User is given a real path, not just a refusal
